Publish.LongDescription:
# Reworked Specialized Industrial Zones (BETA)
**BETA: this mod needs more testing. Please back up your saves and report any problems.**
Adds specialized industrial zones so you can zone industry for one resource chain instead of all of it.
## Zones * Forestry * Agriculture * Ore * Oil
Each zone only attracts companies and buildings that work with that industry's resources. Place Agriculture zones near farms, Oil zones near oil fields, and so on. The normal Industrial zone is untouched, so you can still use it for general industry.
## How it works Zones are filtered by the resources a building makes, stores or sells. A company's inputs are not checked, so a factory that uses imported materials can still appear in a zone that matches its output.
The zones are saved in a JSON file you can edit (highly experimental): `C:\Users\{user}\AppData\LocalLow\Colossal Order\Cities Skylines II\ModsData\ImprovedSpecializedZones\SpecializedZones.json`
## Changes from the original * Only the four general zones are created by default. The "Manufacturing only" and "Warehouses only" variants are turned off, which means fewer prefabs for the game to create. * Faster prefab scan at startup, and the mod writes timings to its log. * Fixes for a few small bugs, including a crash if the mod's files can't be found and an extra reload after a config upgrade.
## Help me test This is a beta and I have only tested it on my own setup (game version 1.6.2). I would love to hear from you, especially if you have saves made with the original mod, lots of other mods, or a big city with slow load times.
Things I want to know: * Do all four zones grow buildings? * Does your save load, and do the buildings stay after you save and reload? * How long does your save take to load compared to the original mod? * Did anything break, vanish or show errors?
When reporting a problem, please include your game version, your other mods if you can, and this mod's log file from the Logs folder.
## Important * This mod REPLACES the original Specialized Industrial Zones. Do not run both at once, because they share the same names. * Cities that used the original's "Manufacturing only" or "Warehouses only" zones will lose those zones while they are off. * Back up your saves before adding any mod.
## Credits Original mod by DillonN (MIT License): [Specialized Industrial Zones](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/106939/Windows). This version continues his work, and his original license and copyright notice are included.
